stories.headline: Archaeologists Found a Skeleton Wearing an Amulet That May Change the History of Christianity - Popular Mechanics
stories.summary: Excavations have revealed ancient human remains bearing a distinctive pendant that could reshape our understanding of the faith's past. Researchers believe this remarkable artifact may challenge long-held historical narratives surrounding early church culture. As analysis continues, the unearthing promises to offer fresh perspective on the sacred heritage of early believers.
